items.prompt: A Soviet military academy courtyard in Saint Petersburg on a grey morning: a row of young cadets seen from behind in greatcoats, and beyond the railings an old space-rocket monument pointing at a low sky.

alt.ru: Двор военной академии в Петербурге серым утром: шеренга курсантов в шинелях со спины, за оградой старый памятник-ракета смотрит в низкое небо.
alt.en: A military academy courtyard in Saint Petersburg on a grey morning: a row of cadets in greatcoats from behind, an old rocket monument beyond the railings.
alt.pt: O pátio de uma academia militar em São Petersburgo numa manhã cinzenta: uma fila de cadetes de capote, de costas, e um velho monumento-foguetão além das grades.
alt.es: El patio de una academia militar en San Petersburgo en una mañana gris: una fila de cadetes con capote, de espaldas, y un viejo monumento-cohete tras la verja.
